name: Windows Health & Network Stack Optimizer
description: Executes core Windows system file repair (SFC) and network recovery operations (DNS flush, DHCP release/renew, Winsock reset) with dry-run impact checks and UAC self-elevation.

tools.name: System File Checker (sfc /scannow)
tools.description: Scans integrity of all protected Windows system files and repairs corrupted versions.

tools.name: Flush DNS Resolver Cache
tools.description: Purges the Windows DNS client resolver cache via ipconfig /flushdns.

tools.name: IP Config Release & Renew
tools.description: Releases and renews DHCP IPv4 addresses via ipconfig /release && ipconfig /renew (temporarily drops active network connections).

tools.name: Reset Winsock Catalog
tools.description: Resets Winsock Catalog to a clean state via netsh winsock reset (requires system reboot to complete).

tools.name: AI Health Output Advisor
tools.description: Uses Central LLM Service to interpret SFC or network reset logs.
